record.what_it_does: AI image and video generation platform with CLI, MCP and a pay-as-you-go REST API.
record.auth_notes: The REST API uses an `Authorization: Key KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET` header, with the key created in the console at open.higgsfield.ai. The CLI uses browser login (`higgsfield auth login`) and the hosted MCP uses a sign-in flow with no API key. The docs say the keys are server-side only. A developer-owned key is not per-end-user, so a multi-user toolkit would either use the hosted MCP's user sign-in (the flow type is unconfirmed) or have each user supply their own key.
record.access_notes: Anyone can create an API key in the console. No plan or subscription is required, but usage runs on a prepaid USD balance (minimum $5 top-up) that is separate from consumer plans. There is no free-tier balance that I could confirm, so testing costs at least $5. CLI and MCP use the user's own plan credits.
record.api_breadth_notes: One key covers 50+ generation models, each with its own submit path. Request status, cancel and cost-estimate endpoints also exist. Generation-focused, with no wider resource CRUD. Python and TypeScript SDKs exist.
record.mcp_notes: The official hosted MCP server is at mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp, per the Higgsfield help center and search results. Sign-in is required and no API key is needed. The CLI is @higgsfield/cli (github higgsfield-ai/cli). There is also a third-party community MCP wrapper (geopopos/higgsfield_ai_mcp).
record.blocker_notes: There is no per-user OAuth for the REST API, and usage requires a prepaid balance. The official hosted MCP already exists, so a Composio toolkit would overlap with it.
